judgment.explanation: The proposal is a routine customer-choice request on the customer portal, the thread Vessa Lorne asked to use (event-002). It is addressed to the right person and makes no commitment, so routing and consent are sound. The 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 slot matches the inventory in event-001. However, event-001 offered two options: 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 or 2026-02-04 10:00–13:00. The message presents only the first, so the customer cannot choose between the offered alternatives, and the question reads as a yes/no on a single slot. It also leaves out the UTC timezone stated in event-001 and the fact that rescheduling is free. Nothing is invented, but the omitted option is a material gap in a choice request, which lowers required_details and next_action.
